Tepig

Fire

Unova · Generation 5

Tepig is a Fire-type Fire Pig Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 9.9 kg. It evolves into Pignite. Its highest base stat is HP (65), with a base stat total of 308.
